title: Largest Clear Lot
statement:
A city map is a grid of `n` rows and `m` columns. Each cell is either `1` (free ground) or `0` (built over). Find the largest rectangle, made of whole cells and aligned with the grid, in which every cell is free ground.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `n` lines contains a string of `m` characters, each `0` or `1`, with no spaces.

## Output
Print the area (number of cells) of the largest rectangle that contains only `1`s. If there is no `1`, print `0`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, m <= 400`
